name: ExactPDF API
description: Use ExactPDF to inspect PDFs, extract text, and create structured Markdown or verified source-pack ZIPs for document workflows. Execution endpoints require an ExactPDF API key; capabilities discovery is public and free. API credits are separate from Max web subscriptions. Server-generated X-Request-Id identifies one execution, not HTTP retry idempotency: do not automatically retry paid calls after an ambiguous response.
